name: Single-Component Reflections of the 1237-Concept Three-Piece Obstruction
definition: Use the shared coordinate of the certified $1237$-concept obstruction obtained by gluing two $330$-concept edge pieces and one $581$-concept edge piece along their common edge. Its complement of the common reduction has six connected components, three in each layer; reflect one component at a time while retaining both lifts over the reduction.
parameters: The obstruction has $1237$ concepts and $37$ active coordinates. The six complementary components have sizes $249,1,249,1,2,1$. Each $330$-concept piece contributes two oppositely labelled components, and the $581$-concept piece contributes the remaining two.
properties: Exactly the four single-component reflections supported in the two $330$-concept pieces are dismantlable ample. Each has a certified full peeling order. The two reflections supported in the $581$-concept piece remain nonpeelable, each with a protected set of $1154$ vertices and explicit missing-cube witnesses. Two fixed greedy peeling orders fail on all six reflected classes, so greedy failure does not distinguish the positive and negative cases. This census concerns the six components of the shared separating coordinate only; it does not classify all component reflections of the obstruction or give an intrinsic sign criterion.
